biological_replicate: Single shot, label-free protein quantifications (LFQs) were obtained from the seven brain regions of 16 individuals
experimental_design: spatiotemporal survey of 7 brain regions across postnatal development
jointly modelling protein changes over time and between brain regions by regression and ANOVA
factor_value: brain region (CBC, STR, MD, AMY, HIP, V1C, DFC), developmental age (1 to 42 years)

7 regions that showed large inter-regional differences in gene expression by RNA-seq were selected: cerebellum (CBC), striatum (STR), mediodorsal thalamic nucleus (MD), amygdala (AMY), hippocampus (HIP), primary visual cortex (V1C), and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DFC). Developmental samples spanned the period from early infancy (1 year post conception) to adulthood (42 years)
number_of_fractions: separated offline by high pH reverse phase chromatography into 15 fractions
number_of_biological_replicates: Single shot, label-free protein quantifications (LFQs) were obtained from the seven brain regions of 16 individuals
number_of_samples: a total of 77 single-shot samples analysed
